test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Sodium carbonate can be used as a cleaning agent for domestic purposes
Sodium carbonate is used in making cake.
sodium hydrogencarbonate is used for making baking power
Sodium hydrogencarbonate is an ingredient in antacids

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium carbonate is used in making cake**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium carbonate**, commonly known as **washing soda**, is a chemical compound with the **formula Na₂CO₃**.
 
• Sodium carbonate is a **white, odorless **powder that is **soluble in water**. It has a **strong alkaline nature**.
 
• It is produced through the Solvay process, which involves the reaction of **sodium chloride (table salt), ammonia, carbon dioxide, and water.**
 
• **Sodium carbonate** is used in swimming pools and other water treatment applications to raise the **pH of water.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sodium hydrogen carbonate, commonly known as **baking soda or sodium bicarbonate**, is a versatile chemical compound with the formula **NaHCO₃.**
 
• Sodium hydrogen carbonate is a **white crystalline powder** that is soluble in water and has a **slightly alkaline taste**.
 
• Sodium bicarbonate is an effective cleaning agent and deodorizer. It can be used to clean surfaces, remove stains, and eliminate odors.
 
• When heated above** 50°C (122°F)**, sodium bicarbonate decomposes to produce sodium carbonate, water, and carbon dioxide.
 
• Sodium hydrogen carbonate is a valuable compound with diverse applications ranging from cooking and baking to cleaning and health.
